parsed.name: UxBus 串口协议通信组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过串口封装、发送、接收并校验 UxBus/Modbus 风格的协议报文。它主要服务于实验系统中的设备通信流程，例如设置协议标识、检查协议头、处理私有协议以及收发请求与响应数据。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component used to package, send, receive, and validate UxBus/Modbus-style protocol frames over serial links. It supports lab-system device communications such as setting protocol identifiers, checking protocol headers, handling private protocol formats, and transferring request/response data.

actions.description: 获取/设置错误与警告状态
检查协议头是否符合给定的事务标识、协议标识和单元标识，用于验证接收报文。
actions.description_en: Check whether a protocol header matches the expected transaction ID, protocol ID, and unit ID to validate a received message.

actions.description: 检查数据是否符合私有协议格式，用于识别和验证专用报文。
actions.description_en: Check whether data matches the private protocol format for identifying and validating proprietary messages.

actions.description: 发送 Modbus 请求报文，包括寄存器地址、发送数据和协议相关参数。
actions.description_en: Send a Modbus request frame including register address, payload data, and protocol-related parameters.

actions.description: 接收 Modbus 响应报文，并按功能码、事务标识、长度和超时条件进行处理。
actions.description_en: Receive a Modbus response frame and process it according to function code, transaction ID, expected length, and timeout.
